artworks.description: The image shows a misty seascape. The horizon is low in the composition, with silhouettes of ships with tall masts and a distant cityscape or structures. The style uses soft brushstrokes blurring the lines between water and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia. The water reflects gentle textures with a soft focus.

artworks.title: The Little Mast
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy street scene near a waterfront. People and dogs are visible on the cobblestone street, with ships docked in the distance. The horizon, ships, and buildings are depicted with precise, delicate etching lines. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones. The sky features lightly sketched clouds.

artworks.description: The image shows a distance view overlooking a body of water with small boats. The horizon line is positioned around the upper third of the image, showing a faint outline of land and larger ships in the distance. The delicate style features fine, sketch-like brown lines defining the elements such as boats and ripples on the water. Near us, a couple of slender posts protrude from the water, while a small boat glides by with individuals rowing. In the background, there is a soft transition into land and sky. The color palette is muted and monochromatic, mainly tan and brown tones, creating a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: The Palaces
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and open bite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a canal with buildings on both sides. The perspective is from across the canal, capturing the full view of the buildings. The horizon is obstructed by the buildings along the canal, which are the main focus. The etching technique creates detailed lines, showing architectural features and reflections in the water. The color scheme is sepia, adding a historical quality, with varying tones for depth. Gondolas are seen on the water, with ornate building facades in the background. The sky blends into the background with subtle linework suggesting rooftops and chimneys in the distance.

The architecture is detailed with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating depth. The color scheme is predominantly sepia. In the distance, people are spread out around the square, including street vendors.

artworks.title: The Traghetto, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street-level view of a narrow passageway or courtyard. The scene is enclosed by surrounding architecture and foliage, with no prominent horizon visible. On the left, two people stand close by, and on the right, a group of individuals gathered around a table. The brushwork features delicate, fine lines depicting intricate details and texture in trees and buildings. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing light and shadow for depth. In the distance, the passageway darkens, with a hint of daylight further ahead.

artworks.title: The Riva, No.I
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a quay from an elevated perspective. The quay is busy with various boats, including a large sailing ship. The painting features delicate brushstrokes with a subdued color palette dominated by soft sepia tones. Figures are seen walking along the quay and engaging in conversation. City buildings in the distance frame the scene.

artworks.title: Two Doorways
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in brownish-black ink on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a Venetian canal scene in an etching style. A large, arched stone doorway and building walls are depicted with intricate lines. The canal leads the eye towards a bridge in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic sepia. Water reflections and a gondola in the canal add detail to the scene. The composition uses light and shadow to highlight architectural details.

artworks.title: Two Doorways

artworks.description: The image depicts a narrow canal lined with buildings. The artist uses detailed etching techniques to create texture and depth. The scene is rendered in sepia tones, giving it a vintage quality. The composition includes an archway with a figure, gondolas in the canal, and densely packed buildings in the background.

artworks.title: The Beggars
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an archway leading to an outdoor area. The passageway has textured stone walls and leads to a bright exterior. Light fills the end of the passageway, contrasting with the dark interior. The background shows a street or open area with diffused light and vague outlines of buildings. The drawing focuses on capturing light, shadow, and texture effectively.

artworks.title: The Beggars
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an archway leading to a sunlit street. The scene depicts a darkened passageway with intricate lines forming the arch structure, along with textures of walls and cobbled ground. An intricate lantern hangs from the ceiling, and shadows cover most of the foreground, while light highlights vague figures and outlines of a sunlit street. Two figures are on the right side, subtly detailed with wraps, and blurred outlines suggest movement in the distance. The drawing contrasts the shadowed passage with the brightness beyond, creating a sense of depth and exploration.

One figure holds a child on their lap, who is facing forward. Other figures can be seen in partial profiles, fading into the background. The setting appears to be indoors, with no exterior elements visible. The scene conveys a quiet, intimate grouping within a shaded area.

artworks.description: This is a drawing of a riverside scene featuring a group of figures and a small boat. The drawing is executed in a delicate, fine-lined style, capturing a tranquil moment by the water. The scene depicts a simple building facade with two small windows, overlooked by a makeshift canopy under which several figures are gathered. The canopy seems to be made of cloth and is hung above an outdoor setting, possibly by the side of a house or a shop. Below the canopy is a group of individuals engaged in a peaceful activity. To the lower section of the composition, near the foreground, is a small boat moored by the water’s edge. The use of shading with crosshatching techniques gives depth and texture to the drawings, and the entire composition is sketched on a simple plain background.

artworks.title: San Giorgio
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a harbor filled with boats and ships. The perspective is slightly elevated, likely from a dock, with a partially visible boat and dock at the forefront. The horizon is in the upper third of the image, showing a distant cityscape with spires and structures. The brushwork is delicate, with fine, linear strokes typical of etching. The color palette is monochromatic, sepia tones creating a vintage and serene mood. The ships with tall masts populate the water, with reflections giving a sense of stillness. In the distance, faint impressions of buildings line the harbor, blending into the horizon.

The canal reflects the structures, with a gondola slightly off-center. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and sepia.

artworks.title: The Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching capturing a canal scene in a historic European city. The horizon line is higher in the composition, aligning with distant architectural structures that diminish towards the top edge, with several buildings flanking the canal. The artwork features intricate, linear brushstrokes emphasizing details in the architecture and figures, creating a delicate yet bustling environment. Close to us are small boats with figures preparing for or in the act of rowing, and a bridge crosses the canal slightly above the center of the image. The bridge is populated with several figures observing the activity below. Beyond the bridge, more figures and gondolas fill the scene, adding life and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on the contrast between the ink and the paper for visual depth.

artworks.title: The Bridge
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Asian wove paper
artworks.description: The etching depicts a canal scene with a high horizon line showing buildings and trees in the distance. The canal winds through the bustling scene, with a bridge as a focal point. Figures are visible crossing the bridge and along its edges. The sketch-like brushstrokes capture a lively atmosphere with minimal detail. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. Boats with figures and people along the canal bank add to the sense of movement in the urban setting.

artworks.title: Upright Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a vast expanse of water leading towards a distant cityscape. The horizon is placed roughly at the upper third of the image, where the cityscape emerges with small architectural structures and larger dome-like buildings creating a skyline. Some tall ships with masts are visible near the city's edge, appearing anchored or in motion towards the docks. The artwork uses fine linear strokes to create a delicate composition. The color palette is mostly monochromatic with variations of gray and beige, giving the scene a muted appearance. Closest to us is a solitary boat gently resting on the water's surface, leading the eye towards the distant city. The sky above features sparse, linear clouds spread out thinly, enhancing the tranquility of the setting.

artworks.title: Upright Venice
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a waterfront with a view of a calm body of water and a cityscape in the distance. Boat silhouettes and buildings are visible on the horizon. The intricate etching technique creates a busy scene with a warm sepia color palette. Figures and boats are seen on the quay, with smaller boats scattered on the water. The background features a soft, cloud-dotted sky, conveying a tranquil yet industrious atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Riva, No.II
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint in dark brown on Asian laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a harbor scene from an elevated perspective. The horizon is defined by a line of buildings along the water's edge. Figures are lightly sketched across an open space, with boats visible to the right. The artwork is created in an etching style, with precise lines capturing architecture, people, and water. The color scheme consists of sepia and beige tones, giving a historical feel. The scene conveys bustle and activity, with people and boats engaged in various actions. Light and shadow create a sense of calm and balance.
